summary: Frontend-only test of SafeVault V2 (Expo web preview, mobile viewport 390x844). Cleared localStorage, ran login → demo → onboarding (perm-drive + perm-notifications + continue) → home → timeline → docs → document detail → family → profile → theme settings → real Google OAuth attempt. SecureStore-on-web crash from iteration_1 is FIXED — demo login now succeeds via AsyncStorage shim and no red error overlay appears anywhere. All required testIDs found, all major flows pass, theme switching propagates accent colors immediately to subsequent screens, Google OAuth popup opens accounts.google.com with the configured client_id and drive.file scope. Chip-wrap regression is fixed (filter-row-status / filter-row-member stay at 40px height even when filter-expiring-soon is activated).

issues: Multiple console warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' (cosmetic, several occurrences from RN web). 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents' (cosmetic). Neither blocks any flow.

spec_deviations_minor.issue: Review request says 'click doc opens detail via doc-card-<id>', but timeline rows use testID 'timeline-item-<id>'. Navigation to /document/[id] works correctly; only the testID name differs. Recommend either renaming to 'doc-card-<id>' on Timeline rows for consistency OR updating spec. Docs tab does emit 'doc-card-<id>' per requirement.

Request mentions testID 'member-view' on the member detail modal. family.tsx only sets 'member-view-close' and 'member-view-edit' on inner controls — there is no wrapper testID 'member-view'. The modal opens and works (shows member avatar, doc list, edit button). Add testID='member-view' to the outer SafeAreaView/View wrapper at family.tsx ~line 142.

'enable-media-btn' is absent on profile-warnings panel. Per agent_to_agent_context_note this is expected on web (MediaLibrary auto-grants), so the optional perm warning never surfaces. Not a bug, but flagging for visibility — only enable-notif-btn and connect-drive-btn render.

verified_working: Login screen: shield logo, SafeVault brand, tagline 'Your documents. Encrypted. Always with you.', 3 feature pillars, login-google-btn + login-demo-btn
Demo login → onboarding-screen with perm-drive / perm-notifications / perm-media / onboarding-continue-btn / onboarding-skip-btn all present and tappable

Bottom tab bar (bottom-tab-bar) at y=787 height=57 (above safe area inset on 844-tall viewport). tab-home / tab-timeline / tab-docs / tab-profile / tab-add-fab all present; FAB centered at x=166 width=58 (390/2 − 29)
Home: vault-health-card (75%, themed dark), drive-usage-card (1.2GB / 15GB, 8% bar), notif-btn opens alerts-sheet bottom sheet listing notifications, permission-warnings banner present

Timeline: timeline-view-toggle with view-all/view-month/view-year all clickable, member filter chips (All members / You / Maya / Aarav) work, 7 timeline-item rows across 4 sections (Overdue, This Month, Next 3 Months, Later), Driving License (expired) renders with red border + red title, Health Insurance (expiring) renders with amber accent, owner avatar+name visible on every doc row, click row → /document/doc_seed_xxx

Docs: docs-search-input, filter-row-status + filter-row-member each 40px tall (single-line, stays single-line after activating filter-expiring-soon — chip-wrap bug FIXED), filter-all/expiring-soon/valid/expired present, member chips on separate row, group-list/group-month toggle works
Document Detail: doc-edit-btn / doc-edit-action open edit sheet with edit-save-btn; doc-download-action present

Family: family-add-btn opens modal with family-pick-photo + family-input-name + family-input-relation + family-input-dob + family-save-btn. 3 seeded members (You, Maya, Aarav) with family-row-<id> + family-edit-<id> + family-remove-<id>. Clicking Maya row opens member detail modal showing Maya's 1 doc (Life Insurance) with edit pencil
Profile: profile-theme-row, profile-warnings (with enable-notif-btn + connect-drive-btn), counts (0 docs / 0 members on first run, 6/3 with seed)

Theme settings: theme-preview live updates, theme-forest / theme-ocean / theme-royal / theme-sunset / theme-mono presets all work, theme-custom-hex accepts #FF5722 and theme-apply-custom applies it. After picking Sunset Orange, /home vault-health-card immediately renders in brown sunset accent

Real Google OAuth: clicking login-google-btn opens popup to https://accounts.google.com/v3/signin/identifier with client_id=77525538924-uhotejhlsgir0vtvrt6355spj7p7t6n8.apps.googleusercontent.com, scope including https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive.file, redirect_uri=https://safevault-audit.preview.emergentagent.com — OAuth handshake correctly initiated
No red error overlay on any flow; zero pageerror events captured during full traversal

context_for_next_testing_agent: Use mobile viewport 390x844. Always start at /login and click localStorage.clear() before testing. Demo flow: login-demo-btn → perm-drive → perm-notifications → onboarding-continue-btn → /home. Timeline rows use 'timeline-item-<id>' (not 'doc-card-<id>'); Docs cards use 'doc-card-<id>'. Family member detail modal lacks a wrapper testID 'member-view' but exposes 'member-view-close' / 'member-view-edit'. On web, MediaLibrary auto-grants so 'enable-media-btn' will not appear. Google OAuth popup will redirect to accounts.google.com — that confirms the integration; do not fail the test on the actual sign-in page.
